title: Design System: Scratchpad — Open Canvas v6

chrome.purpose: Navigation, note rows, section headings, and metadata.

prose.purpose: Document title and matching rendered/Markdown body; 20px desktop, 18px phone.

code.purpose: Inline and fenced code retain the platform mono stack.

shadows.name: flat-shell
shadows.purpose: Navigation, note index, and open writing canvas.

shadows.name: dialogs
shadows.purpose: Existing dialogs and floating utilities only.

motion.name: ease-pop
motion.purpose: Task checkbox feedback and existing entrances.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action in a context. Pill geometry with a colored indigo glow.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: var(--r-sm); border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--t-fast) ease, border-color var(--t-fast) ease, color var(--t-fast) ease, box-shadow var(--t-fast) ease, transform var(--t-fast) var(--press); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); box-shadow: var(--shadow-primary); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-d); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A tinted pill rather than an outlined one — control-fill at 5% ink, no border.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: var(--r-pill); border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--t-fast) ease, color var(--t-fast) ease, transform var(--t-fast) var(--press); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--control-fill); color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--control-fill-hover); }

components.name: Search Control
components.description: Local note search and command entry in the note index header.
components.html: ⌘K
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; height: 38px; padding: 0 10px; background: var(--field-bg); border: 1px solid var(--hairline-color-2); border-radius: var(--r-md); box-shadow: var(--field-inset-shadow); transition: border-color var(--t-fast) ease, box-shadow var(--t-fast) ease; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-focus-ring); } .ds-search-icon { flex: none; color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-search-input { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; height: 100%; border: 0; background: transparent; outline: none; padding: 0; font: 400 13.5px/1 var(--sans); color: var(--ink); } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-search-hint { flex: none; font: 500 11px/1 var(--sans); color: var(--text-muted); background: var(--control-fill); border-radius: var(--r-code); padding: 3px 6px; }

components.name: Note Row — Selected
components.description: Selected note row in the Indigo on Paper index. Warm paper, hairline border, compact title and metadata.
components.css: .ds-note-row { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 16px 20px; background: var(--control-fill); color: var(--ink); border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline-color); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; text-align: left; font: 600 14px/1.4 var(--sans); } .ds-note-row:hover { background: var(--row-hover); } .ds-note-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-focus-ring); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: The privacy guarantee made visible. Carries backup state via data-backup-state: healthy (meadow), aging (amber), missing (rust, weight 600).
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 26px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: var(--control-fill); font: 500 11px/1 var(--sans); color: var(--text-secondary); cursor: pointer; } .ds-status-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: var(--success); flex: none; } .ds-status-chip[data-backup-state="healthy"] { background: var(--success-tint); color: var(--success-text); } .ds-status-chip[data-backup-state="aging"] { background: var(--warning-tint); color: var(--warning-dark); } .ds-status-chip[data-backup-state="aging"] .ds-status-dot { background: var(--warning); } .ds-status-chip[data-backup-state="missing"] { background: var(--rust-tint); color: var(--rust); font-weight: 600; } .ds-status-chip[data-backup-state="missing"] .ds-status-dot { background: var(--rust); }

components.name: Tag Badge
components.description: A tag is a filter button plus an optional remove control. Accent-soft fill, accent text, pill radius.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: var(--r-xs); background: var(--control-fill); color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 12px/1 var(--sans); }

components.name: Brand Glyph
components.description: A 26px gradient squircle at 9px radius with an indigo glow — one of the three sanctioned gradients in the system. Strokes stay white in both themes.
components.css: .ds-glyph { width: 26px; height: 26px; flex-shrink: 0; display: block; background: var(--accent); border-radius: var(--r-glyph); box-shadow: none; } .ds-glyph-lines { stroke: var(--glyph-ink); stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-linecap: round; fill: none; }

components.name: Writing Surface
components.description: The sole raised surface in the app shell. Serif title and readable prose on warm paper.
components.html:
A writing day

A quiet place to gather your thoughts.
components.css: .ds-document { background: var(--surface-document); color: var(--text-body); padding: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; font: 400 20px/1.6 var(--serif); } .ds-document-title { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--ink); font: 500 44px/1.15 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

narrative.overview: Persistent navigation, a month calendar, and a flat document on warm near-white surfaces. The document and stage share one surface; serif prose is the visual focus.

rules.name: Flat shell
rules.body: The document and stage share one surface; no enclosing document shadow or rounded corners.

rules.name: Local first
rules.body: No remote fonts, assets, telemetry, or new network requests.

dos: Use platform serif for prose and sans for section headings.
Match read/edit font metrics and measure.
donts: Do not restore the date rail or decorative date spine.
Do not squeeze the document beside the list on tablet.
